---
title: "Configuration reference: every parameter"
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", echo = FALSE)
library(pelagicOM)
bcfg <- om_biomass_config("BET_ICCAT")
fcfg <- om_fishery_config("BET_ICCAT")

fmt <- function(v) {
    if (is.null(v)) return("NULL")
    if (is.function(v)) return("<function>")
    if (is.list(v)) return(if (!length(v)) "list()" else
                               sprintf("list of %d (table below)", length(v)))
    paste(deparse(v, width.cutoff = 500L), collapse = "")
}
flatten_cfg <- function(x, prefix = "", skip = character()) {
    out <- character()
    for (nm in names(x)) {
        p <- if (nzchar(prefix)) paste0(prefix, "$", nm) else nm
        if (p %in% skip) next
        v <- x[[nm]]
        if (is.list(v) && length(v) && !is.null(names(v)) &&
            all(nzchar(names(v))))
            out <- c(out, flatten_cfg(v, p, skip))
        else out[p] <- fmt(v)
    }
    out
}
param_table <- function(cfg, desc, skip = character()) {
    v <- flatten_cfg(cfg, skip = skip)
    d <- desc[names(v)]
    if (anyNA(d)) stop("parameters without description: ",
                       paste(names(v)[is.na(d)], collapse = ", "))
    data.frame(parameter = paste0("`", names(v), "`"),
               `BET_ICCAT value` = paste0("`", v, "`"),
               meaning = unname(d), check.names = FALSE)
}
kt <- function(x) knitr::kable(x, row.names = FALSE)
```

This page lists every parameter of the two configurations, with its value
in the `BET_ICCAT` preset (Experimento 02) and its meaning. The values are
read from the package, so this page always matches the code. Parameters are
addressed as `section$name`. Change them with `om_config_update()` or with
the `...` of the configuration functions:

```{r, echo = TRUE, eval = FALSE}
cfg <- om_biomass_config("BET_ICCAT", population = list(r = 0.4))
```

```{r}
kt(do.call(rbind, lapply(bcfg$habitat$hotspots, as.data.frame)))
```

### Fleets (`fleets$<name>`, see `om_fleet()`)

| field | meaning |
|---|---|
| `n_vessels` | vessel slots kept active |
| `year_start`, `year_end` | period of activity |
| `regions` | regions the fleet can fish |
| `core_lon`, `core_lat`, `core_sd` | centre and spread of the baseline spatial preference |
| `quarter_weights` | relative frequency of trips per quarter |
| `hooks_median` | anchors (year = median hooks per set) |
| `hbf_mult` | multiplier of HBF |
| `strategy_comp` | composition of strategies (sums to 1) |
| `q_effect` | fleet effect on log q |

```{r}
fl <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(fcfg$fleets), function(nm) {
    f <- fcfg$fleets[[nm]]
    data.frame(fleet = nm, n_vessels = f$n_vessels,
               period = paste(f$year_start, f$year_end, sep = "-"),
               regions = paste(f$regions, collapse = "+"),
               core = sprintf("(%g, %g) sd %g", f$core_lon, f$core_lat,
                              f$core_sd),
               quarter_weights = paste(f$quarter_weights, collapse = "/"),
               hooks_median = paste(sprintf("%s:%g", names(f$hooks_median),
                                            f$hooks_median), collapse = " "),
               hbf_mult = f$hbf_mult,
               strategy_comp = paste(sprintf("%s %.2f", names(f$strategy_comp),
                                             f$strategy_comp), collapse = ", "),
               q_effect = f$q_effect)
}))
kt(fl)
```

### Companion species (`species$params$<sp>`)

| field | meaning |
|---|---|
| `ref` | t per 1000 hooks at the reference |
| `strategy_effect` | log effect of each strategy |
| `hbf_effect` | multiplier of g(HBF), the HBF shape of the target |
| `lat_center`, `lat_sd`, `use_abs_lat` | latitudinal envelope of the species |
| `trend` | anchors of a multiplicative time trend |

```{r}
sp <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(fcfg$species$params), function(s) {
    p <- fcfg$species$params[[s]]
    data.frame(species = s, ref = p$ref,
               strategy_effect = paste(sprintf("%s %+.1f",
                                               names(p$strategy_effect),
                                               p$strategy_effect),
                                       collapse = ", "),
               hbf_effect = p$hbf_effect, lat_center = p$lat_center,
               lat_sd = p$lat_sd, use_abs_lat = p$use_abs_lat,
               trend = paste(sprintf("%s:%g", names(p$trend), p$trend),
                             collapse = " "))
}))
kt(sp)
```

### Observation profiles (`observation$<profile>`)

Each profile is a list of periods. The meaning of every mechanism is in
[Observation and scenarios](observation-scenarios.html).

```{r}
ob <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(fcfg$observation), function(pr)
    do.call(rbind, lapply(fcfg$observation[[pr]], function(p)
        data.frame(profile = pr, period = paste(p$period, collapse = "-"),
                   as.data.frame(p[setdiff(names(p), "period")]))))))
kt(ob)
```

### Scenarios (`scenarios`)

```{r}
sc <- do.call(rbind, lapply(fcfg$scenarios, function(s)
    data.frame(name = s$name, regions = paste(s$regions, collapse = "+"),
               drop = paste(s$drop, collapse = ", "),
               observation = s$observation, objective = s$objective)))
kt(sc)
```
